exclusions.name: Public comment or lobbying
exclusions.why_safe: The decision is by council vote; public input does not directly affect the vote count.

exclusions.name: Mayor or other officials
exclusions.why_safe: The village charter gives ordinance adoption authority solely to the council; no other official has a vote.

exclusions.name: Legal challenges or procedural errors
exclusions.why_safe: The question is about adoption at the session; post-adoption challenges do not affect whether the vote occurs.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether Delgado will actually vote no as stated, or could change her vote or be absent.
